# Splice object options by class

<!-- Generated by tools/splice_options.py from src/game/app/class_registry_options.inc; do not edit by hand. -->

Generated reference for [splice-language.md](splice-language.md) section 4. For each class (CID order), the option ids it adds or rebinds relative to its parent class; all other ids are inherited unchanged from the parent named in the heading. Columns:

- **id**: the option id scripts pass to `geto` / `seto!` (ids above 0x4D0 never reach this table: they are sidebag variables).
- **name**: a label derived from the code (the thunk symbol, whose `RefThunk<Class><NAME>` form carries the script-side name with Q for ?, or the accessor or field), not a script spelling. `+0xNN` is an unnamed byte offset; "sub-object" means the field lives in an object reached through the record's accessor.
- **type**: the value type `geto` returns and `seto!` expects (`object<CLS>` is an object reference whose record names that class; `any` is passed through unconverted; `-` for methods).
- **access**: `get` (`geto` reads it), `set` (`seto!` writes it), `method(n)` (`geto` returns a method taking n arguments), `file` (the level loader can set it from an object's option list), `file-method(n)` (a method only the level loader calls; scripts cannot reach it), `none` (no access word: the id is reserved).
- **rec**: the index of the record in `g_aeopid` (`D_002AC880` in `class_registry_options.inc`).

Using an access a record does not have (for example `seto!` on a get-only option) calls a null function in the original game.

199 classes, 1449 records, 12010 class bindings (1451 new or rebound).
